description: This file defines the main application component for a notes management frontend built with React. It manages state for theme, notes list, selected note, and loading status. It fetches notes on load, supports creating, deleting, and updating notes, and renders the UI components such as Navbar, Sidebar, NotesList, NoteEditor, and EmptyState within an authentication gate.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component for the notes application.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches the application's theme between light and dark mode.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title 'Untitled' and adds it to the list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified note and updates the list and selection.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves updates to the currently selected note and updates the notes list.
